title: Walk to Broadway! Lux 3BR/2.5BA Townhouse!
description:
This spacious townhouse features three levels with a total of 1,500 square feet of living space all to yourselves with private street entrance. Located in downtown Nashville - within about 7 walkable blocks to downtown attractions and venues, e.g., Music City Center, Bridgestone Arena, Ascend Amphitheater, River Front Park, Honky Tonks, Ryman Auditorium, & many restaurants, bars, breweries.

The space
Located in "SoBro" (South of Broadway) area of downtown. in a residential complex with other townhouses with a quiet neighborhood feel.  We enforce "no party" rules and quiet hours.  It's close to everything and yet when you're done with the loud music scenes, you return to your peaceful oasis - your private home away from home.

Exclusive / private use of entire townhouse.

NB: Permitted for short term rental by City of Nashville (Permit #2020033580)

Guest access
Complete access to the entire condo living spaces.  Guests receive an access code effective throughout your stay.
